overview_description.description:
The Daybreak Health startup uses a mobile app to connect teens to teen-specialized therapists. Daybreak Health specializes in providing online counseling services, especially for teens, helping to stabilize their mental fitness.

The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States.

about_short_description.short_description: Daybreak Health specializes in providing online counseling services, especially for teens, helping to stabilize their mental fitness.

product.name: Teletherapy Program for K-12 Students
product.description: An evidence-based teletherapy service providing mental health support to K-12 students, addressing a range of emotional and behavioral challenges.

product.name: Onsite Mental Health Program
product.description: A full-service onsite mental health program providing hiring, training, management, and supervision of K-12 clinicians embedded within schools.

product.name: Universal Mental Health Screener
product.description: A web-based assessment tool for early identification of student mental health needs to guide school support systems.

product.name: Mental Health Classes and Webinars
product.description: Educational classes and webinars for families and school staff on youth mental health topics and support strategies.

product.name: Health Plan Partnership Services
product.description: Collaborative services with health plans to provide pediatric behavioral health coverage for insured children.
